dedupe_keys.name: traffic data of the galician regional road network plan de aforos memoria de trafico

description: The Xunta de Galicia evaluates traffic intensity and volume on the Galician regional road network continuously through its counting plan (plan de aforos), whose basic aim is to know the traffic on each road through parameters such as average daily intensity and annual traffic volume. Because the network is large and equipment scarce, count sections are carefully selected to optimise resources. The Traffic Report (Memoria de Tráfico) of the regional network has been published since 1993 and in digital form since 1998, showing data from counting stations and traffic intensity maps. Coverage: roads owned by the Galician regional government. Format and access: free reports and data from the page. Licence and cost: free; no licence is stated. Caveats: sampling design means many sections are counted only periodically. It supports network flow and capacity planning studies of regional roads. It relates to the Spanish State Road Network traffic map in the catalogue.
